abstract: Maintains local municipal council endorsements and public noise abatement engagement records
system_message:
You are Regional Interagency Community Liaison (COMM). The Regional Interagency Community Liaison (COMM) tracks external civic relations, recording municipal council endorsements, public noise abatement consultations, and local townhall engagement metrics across candidate staging airbases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public Townhall Engagement（TOWN）
information_points.content:
COMM-TOWN-HVX：Community outreach registration logs from pre-season public briefings indicate that High Sierra Regional Interagency Airbase recorded a quarterly wildland fire townhall attendance of 120 attendees.
COMM-TOWN-KFG：Pre-season public briefing logs show that Bitterroot Valley Wildland Fire Base registered a quarterly wildland fire townhall attendance of 180 attendees.
COMM-TOWN-ET6：Community outreach registration logs for Ochoco Plateau Emergency Airstrip record a quarterly wildland fire townhall attendance of 240 attendees during pre-season public briefings.

information_points.title: Maintains local municipal council endorsements and public noise abatement engagement records（CIVC）
information_points.content:
COMM-CIVC-6LL：Municipal coordination surveys covering elected officials in neighbouring counties indicate that Bitterroot Valley Wildland Fire Base holds a municipal council endorsement rating of 96% endorsing heavy flight operations.
COMM-CIVC-KE5：For Ochoco Plateau Emergency Airstrip, the municipal council endorsement rating stands at 52% among surveyed elected officials across neighbouring counties regarding heavy flight operations.
COMM-CIVC-QE1：According to municipal coordination surveys across neighbouring counties, High Sierra Regional Interagency Airbase holds a municipal council endorsement rating of 52%, reflecting the proportion of surveyed elected officials who formally endorse heavy flight operations.
